mapper.select: SELECT id, type, source_id, target_id, directed, weight, status, version, updated_at, properties FROM topology_links WHERE source_id = ANY(#{ids}::text[]) OR target_id = ANY(#{ids}::text[])

WITH RECURSIVE bfs(node_id, depth) AS ( SELECT #{startId}::varchar, 0 UNION SELECT CASE WHEN tl.source_id = bfs.node_id THEN tl.target_id ELSE tl.source_id END, bfs.depth + 1 FROM topology_links tl JOIN bfs ON (tl.source_id = bfs.node_id OR tl.target_id = bfs.node_id) WHERE bfs.depth < #{maxDepth} ) SELECT DISTINCT node_id FROM bfs WHERE node_id != #{startId}

WITH RECURSIVE bfs(node_id, depth) AS ( SELECT #{startId}::varchar, 0 UNION SELECT CASE WHEN tl.source_id = bfs.node_id THEN tl.target_id ELSE tl.source_id END, bfs.depth + 1 FROM topology_links tl JOIN bfs ON (tl.source_id = bfs.node_id OR tl.target_id = bfs.node_id) WHERE bfs.depth < #{maxDepth} ) SELECT DISTINCT tl.id, tl.type, tl.source_id, tl.target_id, tl.directed, tl.weight, tl.status, tl.version, tl.updated_at, tl.properties FROM topology_links tl WHERE tl.source_id IN (SELECT node_id FROM bfs) OR tl.target_id IN (SELECT node_id FROM bfs)
